purpose: Refine the joint frontier at the earliest feasible native handoffs t=0.05, 0.06, and 0.07 using slightly weaker post-handoff amplitudes -0.0148, -0.0150, and -0.0152. Job 004 showed that earlier timing improved both peak width and the t=0.14 Jpk excursion; this audit tests whether that timing margin permits a weaker drive to retain the frozen +0.020% width gate while bringing Jpk to or below the frozen +0.10% gate.
